title: A Book Floor
question: 把今天的“刚换学习角 + 一直整理 + 书太多 + 房间太小 + 书铺满地板 + 书地毯笑话”放进你的生活场景。用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: I have just moved into a new study corner. I have been working hard all morning. I have been trying to get my books in order. This has not been easy because I own many books and notebooks. To make matters worse, the room is rather small. I have temporarily put my books on the floor. They cover every inch of floor space. This is the prettiest book carpet I have ever seen. I can sit here in my spare time and read the carpet.

options.label: A
options.scenario_zh: 说你刚换了一个新的学习角

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.scenario_zh: 说明更糟糕的是，房间相当小

options.label: D
options.scenario_zh: 说这些书占满了每一寸地板空间

options.label: E
options.scenario_zh: 用今天的笑点：你可以坐在这里读地毯
